source: 720p 60 fps compressed YouTube upload (edited montage with webcam cuts)
method: Labelled by eye from 0.5 s kill-feed contact sheets plus single-frame checks; detector output was not consulted. Own rows only (yellow outline/chevron; the player is shown as 'Me'). t = first frame the row is visible.

uncertain.note: Row is under the red death vignette, so the yellow outline looks orange and the right chevron is faint. 'Me' plus the 'KILLED BY SOVA' banner confirm it is the player's death. The row reappears briefly around 255.5 after a webcam cut; that is the same event, not a new one.
Enemy Jett kills allied Jett. No yellow outline or chevron, so this is a teammate death and was not labelled.
0-24 s and about 120-150 s are edited intro/webcam zooms where the kill feed is not in frame. Any own events during those stretches could not be seen.

Timing: the fps=2 sheets sometimes run up to 0.5 s ahead of a direct -ss seek. The t values are first appearance in direct single-frame seeks on the 0.5 s grid; the sheets were used only to find candidates.
